settings.question: Is the game finished?
settings.answer: Not yet — Cortex Labs is in active development. This page carries the playtest build, so expect changes.

settings.question: Can I play it now?
settings.answer: Yes — the playtest runs in your browser. A mouse is required.

settings.question: What does it run on?
settings.answer: Any x86 PC from the 386 era up: VGA, 512 KB RAM, mouse. The whole game is a 16 KB DOS .COM, bootable from floppy.

settings.question: What will the physical edition include?
settings.answer: A bootable 3.5″ floppy, printed manual and collector box. The Limited edition adds a poster, mousepad and USB optical mouse.

settings.question: Where do you ship?
settings.answer: From Poznań, Poland inside the EU — Poland 1–2 business days, EU 3–7 days, calculated at checkout. 14-day EU return right.

settings.heading: Cortex
settings.lede: Build the rails. Harvest the planet. Fill the rocket. Compact logistics strategy for classic x86 — assembly, a .COM file, bootable from floppy.
settings.story_heading: Earth’s last unaging generation is dying.
settings.story_text: You are Orbital Commander. Neurofung grows only on Kepler-486i. A full rocket could change the fate of humanity. Remote link: active.
settings.rules_sub: Build the machine that saves humanity.
settings.play_text: Same .COM. Mouse required. Six seeded maps plus a random expedition. C:\CORTEX\CORTEX.COM — VGA / MOUSE / 16 KB.
settings.box_sub: Built to boot. Made to keep.
